Operating Hours

Monday through Saturday: 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM EAT. Sunday: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM EAT. Orders booked online outside operating hours are scheduled for the next morning window.

Coverage Area

Direct doorstep collection and delivery serving Kilimani, Kileleshwa, Westlands, Lavington, Riverside, Parklands, South B/C, and greater Nairobi.
